How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
To use Synthesia correctly and get the best results, follow this simple workflow: start with Assistant, then generate, then review the stages.  
Start with Assistant
• Write a clear prompt (topic, audience, objective), optionally add a PDF/PPT/Word or URL, pick a duration, and choose a delivery style (Cinematic for fast-paced, Presentation for content-heavy).
• Pick a template (and brand kit if you have it) to keep visuals consistent. 
Build your script
• Paste or type your script in the script box (max 5 minutes per scene). 
• Make sure the correct avatar is linked to the script, otherwise lip sync can be off. 
Generate
• Open the project and click Generate, add a title and description, optionally turn on burned-in captions, then Generate again.
• Watch the stages (Moderating, Queued, Preparing, Rendering, Assembling, Finalizing) to know where it is in the process.
If you want the most realistic stock option, use Express-1 stock avatars (professionally filmed, consistent quality).
